harper: the rim throne. crown emoji awarded. :crown:

zoo: agreed. also requesting a Kiki emoji for #random. vote by reaction :heavy_check_mark: if yes.
matt: vote in favor. will fund the emoji design with one bagel. :bagel:

garden-bot: reaction tally: 5 yes, 0 no. creating custom emoji request ticket.
